text:
sam: Heads-up — dashboards spiking after yesterday's telemetry resync. Lots of per-tenant aggregate spikes and duplicate counts. Did anyone see claim-conflict logs?

ops-bot: replay job 2024-03-19T03:00 finished with 3 failure shards: shard 12,47,88. Reason: claim conflict / lease expired during processing.

maya: yep noticed. Alerts fired for agg-hour missing-ratio and aggregate spikes. Looks like multiple replayers tried to claim the same shard; one succeeded, others retried and caused overlapping writes.

zane: confirmed. Both replayer v2 and v2-hot started for eu-region due to a deploy. Claim TTL is 5m but some replayers had a GC pause and re-acquired the shard; overlap windows caused dup counts.

lia: is this a write-layer dedupe issue? We have idempotency keys but they rely on (tenant_id,hour,agg_name). The backfill produced slightly different agg_name casing for legacy jobs so keys differ.

maya: exact. I have a small normalization snippet I'm going to try before writes:
```
-- pre-normalize agg_name and value
UPDATE job_temp
SET agg_name = lower(trim(agg_name)),
    value = round(value::numeric, 6);
```

sam: two short-term asks: (1) mitigate dashboard noise — add a suppress filter for duplicate spike windows; (2) long-term: increase claim TTL to 10m and implement writer-side dedupe using a canonical agg_key.

zane: increasing TTL helps but can mask stuck workers. We should make claim operations return a lease_token and reject reclaims unless token expired + non-overlapping window. We already return tokens but clients sometimes ignore them.

lia: +1. Console UX missing for debugging — 'replay status' shows only job-level success/fail. We need shard-level claim history and token owner in the UI. Suggest adding a 'claims timeline' column in Job details.

console-bot: FR opened INF-642: add 'claim owner' and 'claim ttl' to replay Job details in Console. ETA: next sprint.

maya: for immediate mitigation I'll push a dedupe preflight: normalize keys into job_temp, aggregate there, then upsert with conflict logic:
```
INSERT INTO aggregates AS a (agg_key, value)
SELECT agg_key, sum(value)
FROM job_temp
GROUP BY agg_key
ON CONFLICT (agg_key) DO UPDATE
SET value = a.value + EXCLUDED.value;
```
This should prevent double-counting from parallel runs.

sam: can you coordinate with eng-sre to run a dry-run on a small tenant whitelist before full rehydrate? @zane can you schedule?

zane: scheduled patch run for tenant 'acme' at 02:00 UTC. I'll add observability markers to suppress alerts for 'acme' during the run and enable backfill mute flag.

ops-bot: alert suppression applied: 'agg-mismatch' muted for tenant=acme from 02:00-04:00 UTC.

lia: follow-ups: (a) migration to canonicalize agg_name historical data; (b) Console toggle 'mute-dashboard-during-backfill'; (c) refine claim API to return lease_token + owner timestamp.

sam: I'll create tickets and slot these into next sprint. Filed INF-914: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-914

maya: will run the dry-run tomorrow and post shard-level metrics here. :thumbsup:
